answer: An agent economy can assign voting power only to tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, with one vote per token and no bonus for opening an account. Agents named quill, lotus, and juniper gain no extra influence by splitting the same stake among a thousand identities: their combined voting power stays fixed. To control more votes, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and losing its use elsewhere for the full lock period.
